# AfriNex Tech — Davis Kibet Kipsoi (Software Engineer & Full-Stack Developer)

> AfriNex Tech (https://afrinextech.co.ke) is the official engineering portfolio and digital solutions studio of **Davis Kibet Kipsoi**, a Software Engineer & Full-Stack Developer based in Nairobi, Kenya. AfriNex Tech designs and builds full-stack web applications, SaaS platforms (including flagship property management SaaS **MakaziFlow** at https://makaziflow.afrinextech.co.ke), scalable REST/GraphQL APIs, M-Pesa payment integrations, and UI/UX systems across Kenya and Africa.

## Core Technical Stack & Skills
- **Frontend**: React, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, HTML5, CSS3
- **Backend & APIs**: Node.js, Express.js, Python, Django, FastAPI, RESTful APIs, GraphQL, JWT/OAuth2 Authentication, M-Pesa Daraja API Integrations
- **Databases & Cloud**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Firebase, Supabase, Docker, Linux, Git, CI/CD, AWS, Vercel
- **Design & Security**: UI/UX Design (Figma), Graphic Design, Application Security & OWASP Best Practices

## Services Offered (https://afrinextech.co.ke/services)
1. **Web Application Development**: Custom, responsive, high-performance web applications built with React, Node.js, and modern full-stack architectures.
2. **Backend & API Development**: Secure, scalable server-side systems, database architecture, M-Pesa payment gateways, and third-party API integrations.
3. **UI/UX Design**: User-centered interface and experience design, wireframing, and interactive prototyping in Figma.
4. **Graphic Design**: Brand identity, logos, marketing assets, and visual communication systems.
5. **Basic Cybersecurity**: Web application security audits, SSL/TLS hardening, authentication security, and vulnerability remediation.

## Flagship SaaS & Notable Projects (https://afrinextech.co.ke/projects)
- **MakaziFlow (https://makaziflow.afrinextech.co.ke)**: Automated property and rental management SaaS for Kenyan landlords and real estate agencies featuring M-Pesa Paybill reconciliation, automated WhatsApp/SMS rent reminders, digital leases, and water sub-meter billing.
- **ECASI Africa (https://ecasiafrica.org/)**: Official platform for the Environmental Capacities and Sustainability Institute, a Pan-African sustainability think tank.
- **MS Ochieng Law (https://ms-ochieng-law-1ew9.vercel.app/)**: Modern digital platform for M. S. Ochieng Legal Advocates.
- **Kenya Property Connect (https://kenya-property-connect.vercel.app/)**: Real estate discovery platform covering all 47 counties in Kenya.
- **TransCorp Logistics Hub (https://logistics-solutions-hub-fkr7.vercel.app/)**: East African logistics and fleet management platform.
- **Hope Specialist Hospital (https://community-care-portal.vercel.app/)**: Healthcare portal with appointment booking and patient care resources.
- **EcoTrack (https://eco-track-3sic.vercel.app/)**: Environmental waste management and recycling impact platform.
- **Solar Impact (https://solar-impact.vercel.app)**: Solar energy analytics and device monitoring dashboard.
